subject: Architecture
title: Le Corbusier: Love Him or Hate Him
description: A short lesson to help you apply Le Corbusier: Love Him or Hate Him.

hook.text: Le Corbusier called a house 'a machine for living in.' Many people found that terrifying.

buildup.text: He proposed demolishing central Paris and replacing it with identical concrete towers in a park.

discovery.text: His five principles — pilotis, free plan, free facade, ribbon windows, roof garden — defined modernism.

twist.text: Cities that copied his tower-in-a-park idea created soulless housing projects that bred crime.

climax.text: His chapel at Ronchamp broke his own rules — curved, sculptural, and deeply emotional.

punchline.text: He wrote the rules of modern architecture, then broke every one.

quiz.question: What did Le Corbusier famously call a house?
options: A sculpture you can live in
